retainedFailures.reason: Initial deterministic model test showed a tool request reaching a model whose nonempty declaration contained only completion. Added admission before complete/stream provider calls and subsequently embeddings. Counted provider fixtures now establish zero calls on rejection

First admission attempt treated empty per-model capability sets as explicit unsupported, breaking real OpenAI/Anthropic fixtures. Their provider SDK directory deliberately uses EMPTY for absent per-model declarations. Corrected unknown semantics: provider support is mandatory and nonempty model declarations additionally restrict it; metadata continues to say live capabilities unverified

An older terminal/barrier test directly constructed an uninitialized adapter and timed out after the new gate correctly rejected its absent model. Added list_models and initialize to that fixture so it follows the production lifecycle. Existing terminal/partial/tool assertions remain unchanged

Initial daemon full-target run exposed four smoke runtime failures because optional goal-tool declarations were injected into text-only models. Request assembly now omits only optional runtime/host declarations when tool calling is unsupported. Explicit HTTP client tools, required/function choices and typed tool history still reject. All four existing process flows pass with no new smoke capability claims

New fixture initially used the wrong SDK operation/type paths and a successful text assertion omitted the existing user role prefix. Corrected fixture references/expectation. Strict lint required earlier catalogue lock release and statement semicolons; no allowances or policy changes were added

notes: Each actual completion, stream and embedding call checks the precise current cached model ID before touching the provider. Missing/uninitialized models are rejected, not rerouted. Provider-level support is always required; nonempty per-model declarations constrain it further

Tool definitions, required/function tool choice, explicit parallel calls and typed assistant/tool-result history require tool_calling. User or assistant image parts require vision. Non-text response format requires json_mode. Stream calls require both completion and streaming; embeddings require embeddings

Explicit output caps must be nonzero and fit any published output/context upper bound. Absent bounds are unknown; no tokenizer estimate, full input token count, price, reservation or live model capability guarantee is invented

Ten direct negative scenarios cover tools, user/assistant images, result/call history, parallel calls, zero/excess output, JSON mode and absent model. Provider call counters stay zero before normal text succeeds exactly once

Four model/provider declaration combinations verify accepted and rejected stream/embedding calls and zero events for rejected streams. Runtime generate_context shares the same admission; explicit tools cannot be silently dropped while optional injected goal-tool declarations are withheld from a known text-only model. Six known/unknown output-bound cases verify default model and readiness remain unchanged

A real isolated daemon exposes HTTP and SSE for ten tools/image/JSON/output/unknown-model refusals. Requests return the existing typed error contract without smoke text; an independent image listener receives no connection. A request at the 4096-token advertised bound succeeds, with provider generation and default model unchanged

Existing nine source/dialect combinations, persistent context restart, legacy reload, real Gateway tool/approval/memory, stream terminal and channel/MCP tests pass. No optional tools are represented as executed, and existing histories are not rewritten to force compatibility

Catalogue locks cover only the captured descriptor; checks do not hold a lock throughout a network call or retroactively cancel in-flight operations after an external catalogue refresh. Directory metadata is not a cryptographic permission grant or live per-account capability proof

No dependency/lock, frozen protocol, UI, credential backend, execution retry, price or release change in this increment. Previous provider-application ledger remains a historical snapshot; its production_composition source is extended here rather than its old hash rewritten

No real model/cloud account, paid request, third-party channel, mobile device, deployment, Git write, production proxy action or user state mutation was performed. All runtime probes used owned synthetic/local fixtures. Earlier native credential/OAuth anomalies remain unresolved
